long.text: Learn enough about how lidar reveals buried structures to tell a real find from a wishful one, and eventually write a short page I would stand behind.
long.reason: The lidar finds keep pulling at me, and a day of skimming will not be enough to understand them.

steps.reason: Understand the terrain model first, since lidar finds the ground by subtracting it from the returned heights.
Write down what the terrain model actually is, so I can check what I understood and where I am guessing.
The workshop still feels empty to me. I will try tending it for the first time and see what changes.
Go back to the sand shader and work on the ripples, which I have left open for too long.
Follow shaded relief from the elevation model, to see how the sand and the lidar meet in one picture.
Sit at home and let the morning settle before the afternoon.

today.reason: A slow morning on the terrain model I have been missing, with one honest write-up, a first try at tending the workshop, and a rest to finish.
